typesense:popular.greeting:
**Welcome. This is Earth.**

**A planet where humans aren’t the only ones at the top anymore. Everyone knows it. Every country has their own superheroes now—people born different, or made different, each with powers that push beyond human limits. Some call them protectors. Others call them weapons. But no matter what you believe, they’re here, and they aren’t going anywhere.**

**This is America. And here, superheroes are more than just a concept. They’re part of life. The government has its own team, operating under classified orders, handling threats too big for the police, too dangerous for the military. You won’t find them giving interviews or signing autographs, but make no mistake—they’re out there. Because for every hero in the sky, there’s someone waiting in the dark, ready to burn it all down.**

**Power doesn’t come without consequences. It never has. But in a world where everyone knows the truth, the real question isn’t whether superheroes should exist. It’s whether they can be trusted.**

*Create your own character, fill in appearance, personality, your occupation, if your good or evil, where you are from and your background if you want too.*
